reports.title: Avalyn Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Recent Business Highlights

desk.headline: Net loss widens to $29.7m on trial spending; AP03 combination enters Phase 1; cash runway into 2029; no financial guidance
results: The net loss widened to $29.7m from $23.6m as R&D rose to $25.5m with the AP01 and AP02 trials under way.
G&A more than doubled to $7.6m on more staff and share-based pay.
A first-in-human study of AP03, an inhaled mix of pirfenidone and nintedanib, has started in Australia.
Cash and securities of $386.6m are expected to fund the company into 2029.
The press release does not give a loss per share.

guidance.summary: Avalyn has no revenue and gives no financial guidance beyond a cash runway into 2029. It expects AP01 (MIST) and AP03 Phase 1 results in the second half of 2027 and AP02 (AURA) results in late 2027.

watch: Enrolment progress in the MIST and AURA trials ahead of 2027 readouts.
Early safety data from the AP03 Phase 1 study.
Cash burn against the runway into 2029.
